footer: Vimana · Sacred Logistics. This letter was sent automatically — you can reply to it, a person reads this mailbox.

verification_code.subject: Vimana · Confirmation code
verification_code.preheader: Your code is valid for 15 minutes
verification_code.heading: Confirmation code
body: Enter this code to confirm that this address is yours.
verification_code.note: If you didn't ask for this code, ignore this letter — nothing happens without it.

recovery_code_used.subject: Vimana · A recovery code was used
recovery_code_used.preheader: Someone signed in with a recovery code
recovery_code_used.heading: A recovery code was used
body: Someone has signed in to your account using a recovery code.
If it was you, there is nothing to do. If it wasn't, sign in and create a new set — the old codes stop working the moment you do.
recovery_code_used.note: This letter is not a subscription: it is the one signal that says a code was spent, and you cannot turn it off.

platform_copy_deleted.subject: Vimana · The key is yours alone now
platform_copy_deleted.preheader: We deleted our copy of your key
platform_copy_deleted.heading: The key is yours alone now
body: We have deleted our copy of your account's key.
From now on only you can sign records and open the vaults of your deals. We cannot do it on your behalf.
If this wasn't you, sign in and restore our copy from your Identity Vault file — the «Access and keys» page in your profile.
platform_copy_deleted.note: An irreversible change is recorded here rather than announced: if it wasn't you who made it, this letter is how you find out.

archive_window_opened.subject: Vimana · Your identity has ended. What now
archive_window_opened.preheader: One decision is left, and it has a date
archive_window_opened.heading: Your identity has ended
body: The key to your identity has been declared lost. You can no longer sign new records, but signing in still works, and everything signed earlier remains valid and verifiable.
One decision is left: whether to keep your public page.
If you do nothing, it stays open after the date below and the choice is fixed. To close it, sign in and choose that before the date — closing cannot be undone afterwards.
Nothing is deleted either way: the chain, the signatures and the deal events remain, because they belong half to your counterparties. Only the shop window closes.
archive_window_opened.note: If you also lose access to the account, there will be nobody to choose and the same thing happens: the page stays.

waitlist_confirmation.subject: Vimana · You're on the list
waitlist_confirmation.preheader: We'll send an invite when access opens
waitlist_confirmation.heading: You're on the list
body: Vimana is a peer-to-peer air delivery platform: urgent and valuable parcels travel with people already flying the route.
We're in closed beta right now. When we open access, we'll send an invite or a registration link to this address. Nothing else is needed from you.
waitlist_confirmation.note: If you didn't sign up, simply ignore this message — nothing happens without you.

waitlist_admin.subject: Vimana · New waitlist signup
waitlist_admin.heading: New waitlist signup
body: Someone left their address on the landing page.

deal_status.subject: Vimana · {{ label }}
deal_status.heading: {{ label }}
body: The status of your deal has changed.

labels.in_transit: The parcel is on its way
labels.delivered: The parcel is delivered — awaiting confirmation

deal_status.note: You can turn deal notifications off in your profile.

deadline_reminder.subject: Vimana · Delivery deadline is close
deadline_reminder.heading: The delivery deadline is close
body: The delivery deadline for your deal falls within the next 24 hours.
deadline_reminder.note: You can turn deal notifications off in your profile.

chat.linked:
Connected. Vimana will send updates about your deals here.

This bot does not hold conversations — it only delivers. Manage which notifications arrive in your profile.
chat.stale:
This link has expired.

Open your profile on the site and press «Connect Telegram» again — links are single-use and short-lived on purpose.
chat.hello:
This is the Vimana notification bot.

To connect it, open your profile on the site and press «Connect Telegram». A bare /start cannot identify your account.

password_reset.subject: Vimana · Reset your password
password_reset.preheader: The link is valid for one hour
password_reset.heading: Reset your password
body: Someone asked to reset the password for this account. If it was you, use the link below.
If it wasn't, no action is needed — the current password still works and nothing has changed.
password_reset.note: The link is valid for one hour and works once. Signing in with the new password ends every other session.

password_changed.subject: Vimana · Your password was changed
password_changed.heading: Your password was changed
password_changed.greeting: {{ name }}, your password has been changed.
body: Every other session was signed out — the new password is the only way in from now on.
If it wasn't you — restore access through the link on the sign-in screen.
password_changed.note: This letter is not a subscription and cannot be turned off: it is the record that this account's way in has changed.

new_device.subject: Vimana · A new sign-in to your account
new_device.preheader: From a device we have not seen before
new_device.heading: A new sign-in to your account
body: This account was opened from a device we have not seen before. Below is what we could tell about it.
If it was you, there is nothing to do. If it wasn't, change the way you get in — the link below leads to your password, your passkeys and your recovery codes.
new_device.note: The location is approximate and often wrong: mobile networks and VPNs can place a sign-in hundreds of kilometres away. This letter is not a subscription and cannot be turned off.

role_offered.subject: Vimana · A role has been offered to you
role_offered.preheader: Nothing has changed yet — it is waiting for your answer
role_offered.heading: A role has been offered to you
body: Someone on the platform has proposed that you take on a role. Nothing about your account has changed: the role begins to apply only once you accept it, and until then you have exactly the rights you had before.
Open your account to see what the role allows, who proposed it, and to accept or decline.
role_offered.note: If you were not expecting this, decline it — declining changes nothing and needs no explanation. This letter concerns access to other people's data, so it is not a subscription and cannot be turned off.
